projects.title: Mobile Shopping Website
projects.description: An online mobile shopping website designed for browsing and purchasing smartphones. The project includes product listings, categories, product details, shopping cart, and a user-friendly shopping experience.

projects.title: Yellow Banyan
projects.description: Yellow Banyan is a complete e-commerce website developed for online shopping. It includes product and category management, brands, product filtering, shopping cart, checkout, and an admin management system.
